en: An old monochrome postcard showing a semi‑rural townscape with a road running along a fortified wall and a multi‑storey building in the foreground. In the middle distance are low houses and a prominent minaret, with hills in the background. Printed text at the top left reads in French: "Canée. Rue menant à Halépa". There is a postal cancellation mark in the upper right corner and a modern website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" at the bottom.
